# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 62 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 47 | Coptic

---

## Saying 62

Jesus said: "I share my hidden teachings only with those fit to receive them. Don't let your left hand know what your right hand is doing."

---

**Translator's Notes (PNEUMA):**

- "Hidden teachings" unpacks *mystērion* for contemporary readers unfamiliar with the technical sense
- "Fit to receive" — worthy in terms of readiness and receptivity
- The right/left hand saying retained verbatim as it is already idiomatic in English
